## Summary
Briefly describe what this pull request changes and why.

## Related Issue
Closes #(issue number)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)

## Verification Checklist
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes with zero TypeScript errors
- [ ] `npm test` passes all unit tests (and new tests added for any math/backup logic changes)
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds cleanly
- [ ] Verified both Light and Dark themes (if UI changed)
- [ ] Verified live PDF preview matches downloaded PDF output (if invoice layout changed)
- [ ] No hardcoded personal/sample data added to initial defaults
